Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
Here's what changed, and how to put it to work.

scenes.headline: Three ways to work, side by side.
lines: Claude now works three ways, side by side.
Chat, to think and draft.

lines.say: Agentic tasks, formerly co-work, to get multi-step work done across your files and apps.
lines.cap: Agentic tasks, formerly Cowork, to get multi-step work done across your files and apps.

lines: And Claude Code, to build software.
And you no longer pick a mode first. Claude moves between them.

cards.d: Get work done — files, apps, finished output

scenes.headline: Four blocks. One system.
lines: Four building blocks make it stick.
Projects. One workspace per workstream.
Memory. One shared memory across chat and agentic tasks.
Skills. Your way of working, loaded automatically.
And artifacts. Live pages, dashboards, and tools you can share.

scenes.headline: Let it run on a schedule.
lines: Then automate the recurring work.
Routines run in the cloud, even with your laptop closed.
Scheduled tasks run on your computer, through the app.

lines: And you set it up in plain English.

scenes.headline: Pick the model by the job.
lines: Finally, pick the model by the job.
Haiku, for speed and volume.
Sonnet, as your everyday driver.
Opus, for heavy, judgment driven work.
And Fable, for the problems Opus can't crack.

scenes.headline: What you just learned.
lines: Quick recap.
Chat to think, agentic tasks to get work done, Code to build. Then make it stick, and automate it.
Your mission: set up one project, one skill, and one scheduled task, for a job you repeat every week.
